Core concepts

Theme

The named values of the utilities come from the theme. These are the default tokens, read directly from jx_theme.

Customize

Add tokens with theme.extend or replace a category with theme.override in jx.yaml. Category names are shown under each heading below.

Z ZASPR Kit

Utility-first CSS framework for Dart and Jaspr, built and tested in Dart.

This site is built with Jaspr and styled only with jx:css.
